metadata.llm_reason: Plugin Prefix Resolution is a distinct micro_skill in the plugin_configuration task family with unique semantic identity (mapping plugin artifacts to short invocation prefixes). It does not overlap with existing skills (Codec Derivation, Link Component Prefetching) which operate in different domains (Scala/circe, Next.js). Peer candidates (Local Repository JAR Installation, Maven Dependency Resolution, Initialize Maven Plugin Development) are related but operate at different granularities and stages: JAR installation targets artifact registration, dependency resolution targets POM declaration, and plugin initialization targets project setup. Plugin Prefix Resolution is orthogonal—it resolves prefix metadata after a plugin exists. Support evidence confirms the capability is documented. No conflicts detected.
